values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $48 a night for a 20/30-amp site, $53 with 50-amp; 2026: $45 / $50 (DNR rates table). The four semi-modern sites without electricity (B1, B2, C1, C2) are booked for tents only, $40 in 2026 and $43 in 2027. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Hoffmaster State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483580: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails, 2026-11-17, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13): fee schedule -32710 (221 20/30-amp sites) $45 / $48 / $48, -32711 (73 50-amp sites) $50 / $53 / $53, -32503 (4 sites, no electricity, allowed equipment 'Tents' only) $40 / $43 / $43 + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Hoffmaster, Campground: 50 AMP $50, 20/30 AMP $45, semi-modern $40) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoffmaster ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoffmaster ('There is 20/30-amp electrical service available on each site (some sites also offer 50-amp service)'; 'Semi-modern sites (no electricity): B1, B2, C1 and C2') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Hoffmaster, resourceLocationId -2147483580: 73 campsites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 297 sites in three loops, most generous and shaded; the booking site allows trailers/RVs up to 20-50 ft by site (about 210 take 30 ft or more). Pull-throughs: 136, 140, 195, 197, 199, 233, 235, 237. Concrete sites 87, 180, 213, 221; ADA sites 5, 13, 70, 131, 145, 232, 241, 248, 259, 261.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoffmaster ('The modern campground is divided into three loops. Most sites are generous in size and are shaded'; 'Pull-through sites: 136, 140, 195, 197, 199, 233, 235 and 237'; 'Concrete sites (open to all): 87, 180, 213 and 221'; 'Number of sites: 297') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Hoffmaster, resourceLocationId -2147483580: 298 campsites; allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to' 20-50 ft, 17 sites to 50 ft; 8 'Pull Through=Yes'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoffmaster ('There are two sanitation stations located just past the campground office ... season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoffmaster (on the Nov. 20-23 deer-hunt closure: 'The campground will already be closed for the season'; no page gives the campground's opening and closing dates; the April 22 - October 21 dates in the DNR table are the reservation season, recorded in booking.season), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/hoffmaster ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Hoffmaster, Campground: reservation season starts 'April 22', ends 'October 21') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (298 bookable campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground on the north side of the park off Lake Harbor Rd, shaded by oaks, maples, beech and pine and next to Little Black Creek and the dune trails. It sits behind a wooded foredune ridge; the closest sites (25-60) are under a quarter-mile walk to the Lake Michigan beach and a buoyed swim area. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + rates table: base raised $40 -> $48 (2027; 2026 $45): the $40 sites are the four tent-only semi-modern sites; high $50 -> $53 (2027). 50-amp confirmed; 297 sites (was 293) to 50 ft with 8 pull-throughs (new); showers confirmed, flush toilets, potable water and dump new. Reservation season April 22 - October 21 into booking.season (new). Seasonal (year_round false) confirmed by the park page ('The campground will already be closed for the season'); no page gives its open dates. Two sites (4, 214) list water and sewer on the booking site; not enough to write water/sewer. Park closes Nov 20-23 for a managed deer hunt, after the campground's season. Phone 231-798-3711 matches. Note trimmed of field restatements and the 'two loops' the DNR contradicts ('three loops').
